recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7980 unless the work group wants a broader editorial rewrite of Resource identity terminology beyond the 2015 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-7980 was Published with a Persuasive, non-substantive clarification for DSTU1. It asked to fix unclear BaseResource wording where "literal" appeared only in the Business Identifier section, making it ambiguous whether the specification meant Resource.id/logical identity or Resource.identifier/business identifiers.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 6469, preserved as git commit 1e51376ec558bf14cc3c0926410609002322315b (#7980 - improve language about identifiers), which rewrote source/resource/resource-notes.xml to distinguish logical id, literal identity/location, and business identifiers.
additional_context: Current source/resource/resource-notes.xml has since evolved to describe Resource Identity as a Location URL based on Logical ID versus inherent identifiers such as Business Identifier or Canonical URL. source/fhir.ini keeps Resource in active build scope. The adjacent FHIR-7982 business-identifier example issue was applied separately and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Resource page already has separate Resource Identity, Logical ID, and Business Identifiers sections, and identifies the identifier element as the business identifier, so the ambiguity reported by FHIR-7980 is no longer present.
